verdicts.title: Spikes wrap score below zero to 65136 instead of flooring at 0
verdicts.observed: Score was 100 and the player hit spikes on tick 5. Score became 65136 (an unsigned wrap of 100-500), while lives dropped 3 to 2 as expected.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0, so the score should be 0 after 100 - 500.

verdicts.title: Spikes drive score to 65136 then negative (-300) instead of flooring at 0
verdicts.observed: Spikes at tick 3 turned score 100 into 65136 (wrap). A later coin then showed Score -300, which is negative.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and spikes floor the score at 0. After the spikes the score should be 0, and a later coin should give 100.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin on a dash
verdicts.observed: After dash-down collected a coin, state.coins is 1 but the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5' while Score updated to 100.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused and frozen
verdicts.observed: After esc then click on btn-restart, the state stays mode=paused with the pause menu still open. Ticks of wait change nothing, and the game never resumes.
verdicts.expected: Restart level resets the level and the game is running again straight away (mode playing, timer 300).

verdicts.title: Toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
verdicts.observed: With the pause menu open, the 'Key collected' toast sits on top of btn-resume, so btn-resume reports top=false and a click there would not reach it.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it, so Resume must be the topmost element at its centre.

verdicts.title: Two dash keys in one tick produce a dash plus a step
verdicts.observed: dash-down+dash-down in one tick moved the player from (1,1) to (1,4): a 2-tile dash plus an extra move, with events dash and move.
verdicts.expected: Only the last movement key in a tick counts, so the player makes at most one move (a single 2-tile dash to (1,3)).

verdicts.title: Spikes push score negative and it wraps to 65136
verdicts.observed: At tick 3 the player (score 100) hits spikes at (1,1)... after the spike hit the score shows 65136 (wrapped from 100-500). Later a coin gives -300 on the HUD, so the score is negative.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes below. Score must stay within 0..999,999, so after the spike hit it should read 0, not 65136 or -300.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin on a dash
verdicts.observed: After dash-down collects one coin, state coins=1 but the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5' (also still 0/5 while paused).
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' right after the coin is collected.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins lags one coin behind the actual count
verdicts.observed: After the dash collects a coin at tick 1, state coins=1 but HUD shows 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD stays one behind (e.g. state coins=2 while HUD shows 1/5 at tick 20).
verdicts.expected: The HUD shows the current coin count, so after each coin it should match the state (Coins 1/5, then 2/5).
